verdict_reason: Coda states its REST API is public and available to all users, with broad read-write coverage of docs, pages, tables, rows, formulas, and controls. Credentials are self-serve through personal API tokens or OAuth2 for the MCP, and no sales, partner, or app-review gate is documented. A Free plan exists alongside paid tiers.
open_questions: Coda API documentation now uses the Superhuman Docs name; confirm whether this app should be cataloged as Coda, Superhuman Docs, or both.
No numeric API rate limits were found; the docs state only a per-minute limit and HTTP 429 errors.
No documented sandbox or test environment for the Coda REST API was found; community threads discuss Pack environment workarounds only.
Webhook evidence covers inbound webhook-triggered automations; no general outbound doc-change webhook API was documented.
The official SDK evidence is the TypeScript Pack SDK, not a REST API client SDK; confirm whether a separate API SDK exists.
OAuth2 for the Coda MCP currently supports only the mcp:all scope; granular workspace/folder scopes are described as coming soon.
